corrections.why: DR-03. Door ink spans x 83.12 to 112.88 with its top at 70.6, which a semicircle of that width meets exactly.

source_notes: Kept: the wing line's overhang past the wing wall at left, the roof slopes ending on the head circle, the head above the peak, the separate adult with two short arm strokes, and the open bottom ends of the adult. The door is drawn before the base group, so the black ground line lies over its foot as on the red sheet (red stops at y 108, the ground line's top edge). Black and red sheets agree here.
